PS_COMPLETION = load_completion('powershell')

def count_indent(line):
    return len(line) - len(line.lstrip(' '))

def parse_scalar(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    if len(s) >= 2 and ((s[0] == '"' and s[-1] == '"') or (s[0] == "'" and s[-1] == "'")):
        return s[1:-1]
    if s == 'true':
        return True
    if s == 'false':
        return False
    if s in ('null', '~'):
        return None
    try:
        if re.match(r'^-?\d+$', s):
            return int(s)
    except:
        pass
    try:
        return float(s)
    except:
        pass
    return s

def parse_block(lines, start, parent_indent):
    if start >= len(lines):
        return None, start
    first_line = lines[start]
    first_indent = count_indent(first_line)
    stripped = first_line.strip()
    if stripped.startswith('- '):
        lst = []
        i = start
        while i < len(lines):
            line = lines[i]
            indent = count_indent(line)
            if indent < first_indent:
                break
            if indent > first_indent:
                break
            stripped = line.strip()
            if not stripped.startswith('- '):
                break
            after_dash = stripped[2:].strip()
            if not after_dash:
                if i+1 < len(lines):
                    next_indent = count_indent(lines[i+1])
                    if next_indent > indent:
                        nested, next_i = parse_block(lines, i+1, indent)
                        lst.append(nested)
                        i = next_i
                        continue
                lst.append(None)
                i += 1
            else:
                if (': ' in after_dash or after_dash.endswith(':')) and not (after_dash.startswith('"') or after_dash.startswith("'")):
                    map_lines = []
                    map_lines.append(' ' * (indent+2) + after_dash)
                    j = i+1
                    while j < len(lines):
                        nl = lines[j]
                        ni = count_indent(nl)
                        if ni <= indent:
                            break
                        map_lines.append(nl)
                        j += 1
                    nested_map, _ = parse_block(map_lines, 0, 0)
                    lst.append(nested_map)
                    i = j
                else:
                    lst.append(parse_scalar(after_dash))
                    i += 1
        return lst, i
    else:
        m = {}
        i = start
        while i < len(lines):
            line = lines[i]
            indent = count_indent(line)
            if indent < first_indent and i != start:
                break
            if indent > first_indent:
                break
            stripped = line.strip()
            if not stripped or stripped.startswith('- '):
                break
            if ':' not in stripped:
                i += 1
                continue
            key_part, value_part = stripped.split(':', 1)
            key = key_part.strip()
            value_str = value_part.strip()
            if not value_str:
                if i+1 < len(lines):
                    next_indent = count_indent(lines[i+1])
                    if next_indent > indent:
                        nested, next_i = parse_block(lines, i+1, indent+1)
                        m[key] = nested
                        i = next_i
                        continue
                m[key] = None
                i += 1
            else:
                if ' #' in value_str:
                    if not (value_str.startswith('"') or value_str.startswith("'")):
                        value_str = value_str.split(' #',1)[0].strip()
                m[key] = parse_scalar(value_str)
                i += 1
        return m, i

def parse_yaml_simple(text):
    docs_raw = []
    current = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.strip() == '---':
            docs_raw.append('\n'.join(current))
            current = []
        else:
            current.append(line)
    docs_raw.append('\n'.join(current))
    parsed = []
    for raw in docs_raw:
        if not raw.strip():
            continue
        lines = []
        for l in raw.splitlines():
            if not l.strip():
                continue
            if l.strip().startswith('#'):
                continue
            lines.append(l)
        if not lines:
            parsed.append(None)
            continue
        root, _ = parse_block(lines, 0, 0)
        parsed.append(root)
    if not parsed:
        return [None]
    return parsed

def yaml_dump(data, indent=2, pretty=False, compact=False, _level=0):
    if data is None:
        return "null"
    if isinstance(data, bool):
        return "true" if data else "false"
    if isinstance(data, int) or isinstance(data, float):
        return str(data)
    if isinstance(data, str):
        needs_quote=False
        if not data:
            needs_quote=True
        if re.match(r'^\s', data) or re.search(r'\s$', data):
            needs_quote=True
        if ': ' in data or data.endswith(':') or '\n' in data:
            needs_quote=True
        if data.lower() in ('true','false','null','yes','no','on','off','~',''):
            needs_quote=True
        if re.match(r'^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$', data):
            needs_quote=True
        if needs_quote:
            escaped = data.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '\\"').replace('\n', '\\n')
            return f'"{escaped}"'
        else:
            return data
    if isinstance(data, list):
        if not data:
            return "[]"
        out_lines=[]
        for item in data:
            base_indent = _level * indent if not compact else max(0, (_level-1)*indent) if _level>0 else 0
            base_spaces = ' ' * base_indent
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                dict_yaml = yaml_dump(item, indent=indent, pretty=pretty, compact=compact, _level=_level+1)
                dict_lines = dict_yaml.split('\n')
                out = base_spaces + "- " + dict_lines[0].lstrip()
                for dl in dict_lines[1:]:
                    out += "\n" + base_spaces + "  " + dl.lstrip()
                out_lines.append(out)
            elif isinstance(item, list):
                nested_yaml = yaml_dump(item, indent=indent, pretty=pretty, compact=compact, _level=_level+1)
                nested_lines = nested_yaml.split('\n')
                out = base_spaces + "- " + nested_lines[0].lstrip()
                for nl in nested_lines[1:]:
                    out += "\n" + base_spaces + "  " + nl.lstrip()
                out_lines.append(out)
            else:
                out_lines.append(base_spaces + "- " + yaml_dump(item, indent=indent, pretty=pretty, compact=compact, _level=_level+1))
        return "\n".join(out_lines)
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        if not data:
            return "{}"
        lines=[]
        for k,v in data.items():
            key_str=str(k)
            if isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
                if isinstance(v, dict) and not v:
                    lines.append(f"{' ' * (_level*indent)}{key_str}: {{}}")
                elif isinstance(v, list) and not v:
                    lines.append(f"{' ' * (_level*indent)}{key_str}: []")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"{' ' * (_level*indent)}{key_str}:")
                    nested = yaml_dump(v, indent=indent, pretty=pretty, compact=compact, _level=_level+1)
                    lines.append(nested)
            else:
                val_str = yaml_dump(v, indent=indent, pretty=pretty, compact=compact, _level=_level+1)
                lines.append(f"{' ' * (_level*indent)}{key_str}: {val_str}")
        return "\n".join(lines)
    return str(data)

def detect_format_from_ext(filename):
    if not filename or filename == '-':
        return 'auto'
    ext = Path(filename).suffix.lower()
    if ext in ('.yaml', '.yml'):
        return 'yaml'
    if ext == '.json':
        return 'json'
    if ext == '.xml':
        return 'xml'
    if ext == '.csv':
        return 'csv'
    if ext == '.tsv':
        return 'tsv'
    if ext in ('.props', '.properties'):
        return 'props'
    if ext == '.ini':
        return 'ini'
    if ext == '.toml':
        return 'toml'
    if ext == '.lua':
        return 'lua'
    if ext == '.hcl':
        return 'hcl'
    return 'auto'

def load_file_with_format(path, input_format_explicit, input_format_flag, csv_separator=',', csv_auto_parse=True):
    detected = detect_format_from_ext(path)
    if detected == 'auto':
        detected = 'yaml'
    docs = load_file(path, input_format_flag, csv_separator=csv_separator, csv_auto_parse=csv_auto_parse)
    return docs, detected

def load_file(path, input_format, csv_separator=',', csv_auto_parse=True):
    if path == '-':
        content = sys.stdin.read()
        filename = '-'
    else:
        try:
            with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                content = f.read()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: open {path}: no such file or directory\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        filename = path

    fmt = input_format
    detected_fmt = 'yaml'
    if fmt == 'auto' or fmt == 'a':
        detected_ext = detect_format_from_ext(filename)
        if detected_ext == 'auto':
            stripped = content.strip()
            if stripped.startswith('{') or stripped.startswith('['):
                try:
                    json.loads(stripped)
                    fmt = 'json'
                    detected_fmt = 'json'
                except:
                    fmt = 'yaml'
                    detected_fmt = 'yaml'
            else:
                fmt = 'yaml'
                detected_fmt = 'yaml'
        else:
            fmt = detected_ext
            detected_fmt = detected_ext
    else:
        fmt = input_format
        detected_fmt = detect_format_from_ext(filename)
        if detected_fmt == 'auto':
            detected_fmt = 'yaml'

    if fmt in ('yaml', 'y', 'kyaml', 'ky'):
        try:
            docs = parse_yaml_simple(content)
            if not docs:
                return [None]
            return docs
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad file '{path}': {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    elif fmt in ('json', 'j'):
        try:
            data = json.loads(content) if content.strip() else None
            return [data] if data is not None else [None]
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad file '{path}': {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    elif fmt in ('csv', 'c'):
        try:
            lines = content.splitlines()
            if not lines:
                return [[]]
            reader = csv.DictReader(lines, delimiter=csv_separator)
            rows = []
            for row in reader:
                if csv_auto_parse:
                    parsed_row = {k: parse_scalar(v) for k,v in row.items()}
                    rows.append(parsed_row)
                else:
                    rows.append(dict(row))
            return [rows]
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad file '{path}': {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    elif fmt in ('xml', 'x'):
        try:
            import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
            root = ET.fromstring(content)
            def elem_to_dict(elem):
                d = {}
                for k,v in elem.attrib.items():
                    d[f"+@{k}"] = v
                children = list(elem)
                if children:
                    child_dict = {}
                    for child in children:
                        child_data = elem_to_dict(child)
                        tag = child.tag
                        if tag in child_dict:
                            if not isinstance(child_dict[tag], list):
                                child_dict[tag] = [child_dict[tag]]
                            child_dict[tag].append(child_data)
                        else:
                            child_dict[tag] = child_data
                    d.update(child_dict)
                text = (elem.text or "").strip()
                if text:
                    if d:
                        d["+content"] = text
                    else:
                        return text
                return d
            data = {root.tag: elem_to_dict(root)}
            return [data]
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad file '{path}': {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    elif fmt in ('props', 'p'):
        try:
            data = {}
            for line in content.splitlines():
                line=line.strip()
                if not line or line.startswith('#'):
                    continue
                if '=' in line:
                    k,v = line.split('=',1)
                elif ':' in line:
                    k,v = line.split(':',1)
                else:
                    continue
                k=k.strip()
                v=v.strip()
                cur = data
                parts = k.split('.')
                for part in parts[:-1]:
                    if part not in cur:
                        cur[part] = {}
                    cur = cur[part]
                cur[parts[-1]] = parse_scalar(v)
            return [data]
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad file '{path}': {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    elif fmt in ('ini', 'i'):
        try:
            import configparser
            parser = configparser.ConfigParser()
            parser.read_string(content)
            data = {}
            for section in parser.sections():
                data[section] = {}
                for k,v in parser.items(section):
                    data[section][k] = parse_scalar(v)
            return [data]
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad file '{path}': {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    elif fmt == 'toml':
        try:
            try:
                import tomli
                data = tomli.loads(content)
            except:
                data = {}
                cur = data
                for line in content.splitlines():
                    line=line.strip()
                    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
                        continue
                    if line.startswith('[') and line.endswith(']'):
                        section = line[1:-1].strip()
                        cur = data
                        for part in section.split('.'):
                            if part not in cur:
                                cur[part] = {}
                            cur = cur[part]
                    elif '=' in line:
                        k,v = line.split('=',1)
                        k=k.strip()
                        v=v.strip()
                        if (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')) or (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")):
                            v=v[1:-1]
                        cur[k] = parse_scalar(v)
            return [data]
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad file '{path}': {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    elif fmt == 'base64':
        try:
            import base64
            decoded = base64.b64decode(content).decode('utf-8')
            return [decoded]
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad file '{path}': {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    elif fmt == 'uri':
        try:
            import urllib.parse
            decoded = urllib.parse.unquote(content.strip())
            return [decoded]
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad file '{path}': {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        try:
            docs = parse_yaml_simple(content)
            return docs
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad file '{path}': {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)

def dump_data(data, output_format, indent=2, pretty=False, compact=False, no_doc=False, unwrap_scalar=True, colors=False, csv_separator=',', properties_separator=" = ", properties_brackets=False, shell_sep="_", lua_prefix="return ", lua_suffix=";\n", lua_globals=False, lua_unquoted=False, xml_attr_prefix="+@", xml_content_name="+content", **kwargs):
    fmt = output_format
    if fmt == 'auto' or fmt == 'a':
        fmt = 'yaml'
    is_scalar = not isinstance(data, (dict, list))
    if fmt in ('yaml', 'y', 'kyaml', 'ky'):
        if is_scalar and unwrap_scalar:
            if data is None:
                return "null\n"
            if isinstance(data, bool):
                return ("true\n" if data else "false\n")
            if isinstance(data, (int,float)):
                if colors:
                    return f"\x1b[95m{data}\x1b[0m\n"
                return f"{data}\n"
            if isinstance(data, str):
                if colors:
                    return f"\x1b[32m{data}\x1b[0m\n"
                return f"{data}\n"
        out = yaml_dump(data, indent=indent, pretty=pretty, compact=compact, _level=0)
        if not out.endswith('\n'):
            out += '\n'
        if colors:
            colored_lines = []
            for line in out.splitlines():
                m = re.match(r'^(\s*)(- )?([^:]+):(.*)$', line)
                if m:
                    sp, dash, key, rest = m.groups()
                    dash = dash or ''
                    key_colored = f"\x1b[36m{key}\x1b[0m"
                    rest_stripped = rest.strip()
                    if re.match(r'^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$', rest_stripped):
                        rest_colored = f"\x1b[95m{rest}\x1b[0m"
                    elif rest_stripped:
                        leading = rest[:len(rest)-len(rest.lstrip())]
                        val = rest.lstrip()
                        rest_colored = f"{leading}\x1b[32m{val}\x1b[0m"
                    else:
                        rest_colored = rest
                    colored_lines.append(f"{sp}{dash}{key_colored}:{rest_colored}")
                else:
                    m2 = re.match(r'^(\s*)- (.*)$', line)
                    if m2:
                        sp, val = m2.groups()
                        if re.match(r'^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$', val.strip()):
                            val_colored = f"\x1b[95m{val}\x1b[0m"
                        elif val.strip():
                            val_colored = f"\x1b[32m{val}\x1b[0m"
                        else:
                            val_colored = val
                        colored_lines.append(f"{sp}- {val_colored}")
                    else:
                        colored_lines.append(line)
            out = "\n".join(colored_lines) + "\n"
        return out
    elif fmt in ('json', 'j'):
        try:
            return json.dumps(data, indent=indent) + "\n"
        except:
            return json.dumps(data) + "\n"
    elif fmt in ('props', 'p'):
        def flatten(d, prefix=''):
            items = []
            if isinstance(d, dict):
                for k,v in d.items():
                    new_key = f"{prefix}.{k}" if prefix else k
                    if isinstance(v, dict):
                        items.extend(flatten(v, new_key).items())
                    elif isinstance(v, list):
                        if properties_brackets:
                            for i, elem in enumerate(v):
                                new_key_b = f"{new_key}[{i}]"
                                if isinstance(elem, dict):
                                    items.extend(flatten(elem, new_key_b).items())
                                else:
                                    items.append((new_key_b, elem))
                        else:
                            for i, elem in enumerate(v):
                                new_key_d = f"{new_key}.{i}"
                                if isinstance(elem, dict):
                                    items.extend(flatten(elem, new_key_d).items())
                                else:
                                    items.append((new_key_d, elem))
                    else:
                        items.append((new_key, v))
                return dict(items)
            else:
                return {prefix: d}
        flat = flatten(data)
        sep = properties_separator
        lines = []
        for k,v in flat.items():
            if isinstance(v, bool):
                v_str = "true" if v else "false"
            elif v is None:
                v_str = ""
            else:
                v_str = str(v)
            lines.append(f"{k}{sep}{v_str}")
        return "\n".join(lines) + "\n" if lines else "\n"
    elif fmt in ('shell', 's'):
        def flatten(d, prefix=''):
            items = []
            if isinstance(d, dict):
                for k,v in d.items():
                    new_key = f"{prefix}{shell_sep}{k}" if prefix else k
                    if isinstance(v, dict):
                        items.extend(flatten(v, new_key).items())
                    elif isinstance(v, list):
                        for i, elem in enumerate(v):
                            new_key_i = f"{new_key}{shell_sep}{i}"
                            if isinstance(elem, dict):
                                items.extend(flatten(elem, new_key_i).items())
                            else:
                                items.append((new_key_i, elem))
                    else:
                        items.append((new_key, v))
                return dict(items)
            else:
                return {prefix: d}
        flat = flatten(data)
        lines = []
        for k,v in flat.items():
            if isinstance(v, bool):
                v_str = "true" if v else "false"
            elif v is None:
                v_str = ""
            else:
                v_str = str(v)
            lines.append(f"{k}={v_str}")
        return "\n".join(lines) + "\n" if lines else "\n"
    elif fmt in ('lua', 'l'):
        def to_lua(d, lvl=0):
            ind = "\t" * lvl
            if isinstance(d, dict):
                if not d:
                    return "{}"
                lines = ["{"]
                for k,v in d.items():
                    if isinstance(k, str) and re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$', k) and lua_unquoted:
                        key_str = k
                    else:
                        key_str = f'["{k}"]'
                    val_str = to_lua(v, lvl+1)
                    lines.append(f"{ind}\t{key_str} = {val_str};")
                lines.append(f"{ind}}}")
                return "\n".join(lines)
            elif isinstance(d, list):
                if not d:
                    return "{}"
                lines = ["{"]
                for elem in d:
                    val_str = to_lua(elem, lvl+1)
                    lines.append(f"{ind}\t{val_str},")
                lines.append(f"{ind}}}")
                return "\n".join(lines)
            elif isinstance(d, str):
                escaped = d.replace('"', '\\"')
                return f'"{escaped}"'
            elif isinstance(d, bool):
                return "true" if d else "false"
            elif d is None:
                return "nil"
            else:
                return str(d)
        lua_data = to_lua(data, 0)
        if lua_globals:
            if isinstance(data, dict):
                out = ""
                for k,v in data.items():
                    if isinstance(k, str) and re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$', k):
                        key_var = k
                    else:
                        key_var = f'["{k}"]' if not lua_unquoted else k
                        if lua_unquoted and isinstance(k, str):
                            key_var = k
                    val_str = to_lua(v, 0)
                    out += f"{key_var} = {val_str};\n"
                return out
            else:
                return lua_data + ";\n"
        else:
            return f"{lua_prefix}{lua_data}{lua_suffix}"
    elif fmt in ('xml', 'x'):
        def dict_to_xml(tag, d):
            if isinstance(d, dict):
                attrs = ""
                content = ""
                text_content = ""
                for k,v in d.items():
                    if k.startswith(xml_attr_prefix):
                        attr_name = k[len(xml_attr_prefix):]
                        attrs += f' {attr_name}="{v}"'
                    elif k == xml_content_name:
                        text_content = str(v)
                    else:
                        if isinstance(v, list):
                            for elem in v:
                                content += dict_to_xml(k, elem)
                        else:
                            content += dict_to_xml(k, v)
                if content or text_content:
                    return f"<{tag}{attrs}>{text_content}{content}</{tag}>"
                else:
                    return f"<{tag}{attrs}/>"
            elif isinstance(d, list):
                out = ""
                for elem in d:
                    out += dict_to_xml(tag, elem)
                return out
            else:
                return f"<{tag}>{d}</{tag}>"
        if isinstance(data, dict) and len(data) == 1:
            root_tag = list(data.keys())[0]
            return dict_to_xml(root_tag, data[root_tag]) + "\n"
        else:
            out = ""
            if isinstance(data, dict):
                for k,v in data.items():
                    out += dict_to_xml(k, v)
            return out + "\n"
    elif fmt == 'csv':
        import csv as csvmod, io
        if isinstance(data, list):
            if not data:
                return ""
            headers = []
            for row in data:
                if isinstance(row, dict):
                    for k in row.keys():
                        if k not in headers:
                            headers.append(k)
            output = io.StringIO()
            writer = csvmod.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=headers, delimiter=csv_separator)
            writer.writeheader()
            for row in data:
                if isinstance(row, dict):
                    writer.writerow(row)
            return output.getvalue()
        elif isinstance(data, dict):
            import io
            headers = list(data.keys())
            output = io.StringIO()
            writer = csvmod.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=headers, delimiter=csv_separator)
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerow(data)
            return output.getvalue()
        else:
            return str(data) + "\n"
    elif fmt == 'tsv':
        import csv as csvmod, io
        sep = '\t'
        if isinstance(data, list):
            if not data:
                return ""
            headers = []
            for row in data:
                if isinstance(row, dict):
                    for k in row.keys():
                        if k not in headers:
                            headers.append(k)
            output = io.StringIO()
            writer = csvmod.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=headers, delimiter=sep)
            writer.writeheader()
            for row in data:
                if isinstance(row, dict):
                    writer.writerow(row)
            return output.getvalue()
        else:
            return str(data) + "\n"
    elif fmt == 'base64':
        import base64
        if isinstance(data, str):
            encoded = base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()
            return encoded + "\n"
        else:
            sys.stderr.write("Error: cannot encode !!map as base64, can only operate on strings\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    elif fmt == 'uri':
        import urllib.parse
        if isinstance(data, str):
            return urllib.parse.quote(data, safe='') + "\n"
        else:
            sys.stderr.write("Error: cannot encode !!map as URI, can only operate on strings. Please first pipe through another encoding operator to convert the value to a string\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        return yaml_dump(data, indent=indent, pretty=pretty, compact=compact, _level=0) + "\n"

def parse_path(path):
    if not path.startswith('.'):
        return None
    if path == '.':
        return []
    tokens = []
    parts = path.split('.')
    for part in parts:
        if part == '':
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^([^\[\]]*)((?:\[[^\]]*\])*)$', part)
        if not m:
            continue
        base = m.group(1)
        brackets = m.group(2)
        if base:
            tokens.append(('key', base))
        if brackets:
            for inner in re.findall(r'\[([^\]]*)\]', brackets):
                if inner == '':
                    tokens.append(('iter', None))
                else:
                    inner_stripped = inner.strip()
                    if (inner_stripped.startswith('"') and inner_stripped.endswith('"')) or (inner_stripped.startswith("'") and inner_stripped.endswith("'")):
                        inner_stripped = inner_stripped[1:-1]
                        tokens.append(('key', inner_stripped))
                    else:
                        try:
                            idx = int(inner_stripped)
                            tokens.append(('index', idx))
                        except:
                            tokens.append(('key', inner_stripped))
    return tokens

def eval_path(data, tokens):
    if tokens is None:
        return [data]
    if len(tokens) == 0:
        return [data]
    current = [data]
    for typ, val in tokens:
        next_current = []
        for ctx in current:
            if ctx is None:
                if typ == 'key':
                    next_current.append(None)
                elif typ == 'index':
                    next_current.append(None)
                continue
            if typ == 'key':
                if isinstance(ctx, dict):
                    if val in ctx:
                        next_current.append(ctx[val])
                    else:
                        next_current.append(None)
                elif isinstance(ctx, list):
                    found = False
                    for item in ctx:
                        if isinstance(item, dict) and val in item:
                            next_current.append(item[val])
                            found = True
                    if not found:
                        next_current.append(None)
                else:
                    next_current.append(None)
            elif typ == 'index':
                if isinstance(ctx, list):
                    if 0 <= val < len(ctx):
                        next_current.append(ctx[val])
                    else:
                        next_current.append(None)
                else:
                    next_current.append(None)
            elif typ == 'iter':
                if isinstance(ctx, list):
                    next_current.extend(ctx)
        current = next_current
    return current

def deep_merge(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, dict) and isinstance(b, dict):
        res = dict(a)
        for k,v in b.items():
            if k in res:
                res[k] = deep_merge(res[k], v)
            else:
                res[k] = v
        return res
    elif isinstance(a, list) and isinstance(b, list):
        return b
    else:
        return b

def set_path(data, tokens, value):
    if not tokens:
        return value
    cur = data
    for i, (typ, val) in enumerate(tokens):
        is_last = i == len(tokens)-1
        if typ == 'key':
            if is_last:
                if isinstance(cur, dict):
                    cur[val] = value
                return data
            else:
                if not isinstance(cur, dict):
                    return data
                if val not in cur or cur[val] is None:
                    if i+1 < len(tokens):
                        next_typ,_ = tokens[i+1]
                        if next_typ in ('index','iter'):
                            cur[val] = []
                        else:
                            cur[val] = {}
                    else:
                        cur[val] = {}
                if not isinstance(cur[val], (dict, list)):
                    next_typ,_ = tokens[i+1] if i+1 < len(tokens) else (None,None)
                    if next_typ in ('index','iter'):
                        cur[val] = []
                    else:
                        cur[val] = {}
                cur = cur[val]
        elif typ == 'index':
            if not isinstance(cur, list):
                return data
            while len(cur) <= val:
                cur.append(None)
            if is_last:
                cur[val] = value
                return data
            else:
                if cur[val] is None:
                    next_typ,_ = tokens[i+1] if i+1 < len(tokens) else (None,None)
                    if next_typ in ('index','iter'):
                        cur[val] = []
                    else:
                        cur[val] = {}
                cur = cur[val]
    return data

def eval_literal(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    if len(s) >= 2 and ((s[0] == '"' and s[-1] == '"') or (s[0] == "'" and s[-1] == "'")):
        inner = s[1:-1]
        inner = inner.replace('\\"', '"').replace("\\'", "'").replace('\\\\', '\\')
        return inner
    if s == 'true':
        return True
    if s == 'false':
        return False
    if s == 'null':
        return None
    try:
        if '.' in s or 'e' in s.lower():
            return float(s)
        else:
            return int(s)
    except:
        pass
    if (s.startswith('{') and s.endswith('}')) or (s.startswith('[') and s.endswith(']')):
        try:
            return json.loads(s)
        except:
            pass
    return None

def split_expression(expr):
    parts = []
    current = ''
    in_single = False
    in_double = False
    paren_depth = 0
    bracket_depth = 0
    brace_depth = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(expr):
        c = expr[i]
        if c == "'" and not in_double:
            if i==0 or expr[i-1] != '\\':
                in_single = not in_single
            current += c
        elif c == '"' and not in_single:
            if i==0 or expr[i-1] != '\\':
                in_double = not in_double
            current += c
        elif not in_single and not in_double:
            if c == '(':
                paren_depth += 1
                current += c
            elif c == ')':
                paren_depth -= 1
                current += c
            elif c == '[':
                bracket_depth += 1
                current += c
            elif c == ']':
                bracket_depth -= 1
                current += c
            elif c == '{':
                brace_depth += 1
                current += c
            elif c == '}':
                brace_depth -= 1
                current += c
            elif c == '|' and paren_depth == 0 and bracket_depth == 0 and brace_depth == 0:
                if i+1 < len(expr) and expr[i+1] == '=':
                    current += c
                else:
                    parts.append(current.strip())
                    current = ''
            else:
                current += c
        else:
            current += c
        i += 1
    if current.strip():
        parts.append(current.strip())
    return parts

def find_top_level_op(expr_str, op):
    in_single=False
    in_double=False
    paren=0
    bracket=0
    brace=0
    i=0
    while i < len(expr_str):
        c=expr_str[i]
        if c=="'" and not in_double:
            if i==0 or expr_str[i-1]!='\\':
                in_single=not in_single
        elif c=='"' and not in_single:
            if i==0 or expr_str[i-1]!='\\':
                in_double=not in_double
        elif not in_single and not in_double:
            if c=='(':
                paren+=1
            elif c==')':
                paren-=1
            elif c=='[':
                bracket+=1
            elif c==']':
                bracket-=1
            elif c=='{':
                brace+=1
            elif c=='}':
                brace-=1
            elif paren==0 and bracket==0 and brace==0:
                if expr_str[i:i+len(op)]==op:
                    return i
        i+=1
    return -1

def eval_expr_single(data, expr, context):
    expr = expr.strip()
    if not expr:
        return [data]
    if re.match(r'^\$[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$', expr):
        var_name = expr[1:]
        if var_name in context:
            val = context[var_name]
            return [val]
        else:
            return [None]
    if expr.startswith('select('):
        depth = 0
        in_single = False
        in_double = False
        end_idx = -1
        for i,ch in enumerate(expr):
            if ch == "'" and not in_double:
                if i==0 or expr[i-1] != '\\':
                    in_single = not in_single
            elif ch == '"' and not in_single:
                if i==0 or expr[i-1] != '\\':
                    in_double = not in_double
            elif not in_single and not in_double:
                if ch == '(':
                    depth+=1
                elif ch == ')':
                    depth-=1
                    if depth==0:
                        end_idx = i
                        break
        if end_idx != -1:
            after = expr[end_idx+1:].strip()
            if not after:
                inner = expr[7:end_idx].strip()
                cond_result = eval_condition(data, inner, context)
                if cond_result:
                    return [data]
                else:
                    return []
    if expr == 'keys':
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return [list(data.keys())]
        elif isinstance(data, list):
            return [list(range(len(data)))]
        else:
            return [None]
    if expr == 'length':
        if isinstance(data, (str, list, dict)):
            return [len(data)]
        else:
            return [None]
    if expr == 'type':
        if data is None:
            return ["!!null"]
        if isinstance(data, bool):
            return ["!!bool"]
        if isinstance(data, int):
            return ["!!int"]
        if isinstance(data, float):
            return ["!!float"]
        if isinstance(data, str):
            return ["!!str"]
        if isinstance(data, list):
            return ["!!seq"]
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return ["!!map"]
        return ["!!unknown"]
    if expr == 'tag':
        if data is None:
            return ["!!null"]
        if isinstance(data, bool):
            return ["!!bool"]
        if isinstance(data, int):
            return ["!!int"]
        if isinstance(data, float):
            return ["!!float"]
        if isinstance(data, str):
            return ["!!str"]
        if isinstance(data, list):
            return ["!!seq"]
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return ["!!map"]
        return ["!!unknown"]
    if expr in ('fileIndex', 'fi'):
        return [context.get('fi', 0)]
    if expr in ('documentIndex', 'di'):
        return [context.get('di', 0)]
    if expr == 'filename':
        return [context.get('filename', '')]
    if expr.startswith('strenv('):
        depth = 0
        in_single = False
        in_double = False
        end_idx = -1
        for i,ch in enumerate(expr):
            if ch == "'" and not in_double:
                if i==0 or expr[i-1] != '\\':
                    in_single = not in_single
            elif ch == '"' and not in_single:
                if i==0 or expr[i-1] != '\\':
                    in_double = not in_double
            elif not in_single and not in_double:
                if ch == '(':
                    depth+=1
                elif ch == ')':
                    depth-=1
                    if depth==0:
                        end_idx = i
                        break
        if end_idx != -1:
            after = expr[end_idx+1:].strip()
            if not after:
                if context.get('disable_env'):
                    sys.stderr.write("Error: env operations have been disabled\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
                var_name = expr[7:end_idx].strip()
                if (var_name.startswith('"') and var_name.endswith('"')) or (var_name.startswith("'") and var_name.endswith("'")):
                    var_name = var_name[1:-1]
                val = os.getenv(var_name, "")
                return [val]
    if expr.startswith('load('):
        depth = 0
        in_single = False
        in_double = False
        end_idx = -1
        for i,ch in enumerate(expr):
            if ch == "'" and not in_double:
                if i==0 or expr[i-1] != '\\':
                    in_single = not in_single
            elif ch == '"' and not in_single:
                if i==0 or expr[i-1] != '\\':
                    in_double = not in_double
            elif not in_single and not in_double:
                if ch == '(':
                    depth+=1
                elif ch == ')':
                    depth-=1
                    if depth==0:
                        end_idx = i
                        break
        if end_idx != -1:
            after = expr[end_idx+1:].strip()
            if not after:
                arg = expr[5:end_idx].strip()
                if (arg.startswith('"') and arg.endswith('"')) or (arg.startswith("'") and arg.endswith("'")):
                    arg = arg[1:-1]
                if context.get('disable_file'):
                    sys.stderr.write("Error: file operations have been disabled\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
                try:
                    docs, _ = load_file_with_format(arg, False, 'auto')
                    if len(docs) == 1:
                        return [docs[0]]
                    else:
                        return [docs[0]]
                except SystemExit as e:
                    raise
                except Exception as ex:
                    sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {ex}\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
    m = re.match(r'^collect\((.+)\)$', expr)
    if m:
        inner = m.group(1).strip()
        all_docs = context.get('all_docs', [])
        if inner == '.':
            return [all_docs]
        else:
            collected = []
            for d in all_docs:
                res = eval_expr(d, inner, context)
                collected.extend(res)
            return [collected]
    if expr.startswith('[') and expr.endswith(']'):
        inner = expr[1:-1].strip()
        if not inner:
            return [[]]
        res = eval_expr(data, inner, context)
        return [res]
    if expr == 'to_entries':
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            entries = [{"key": k, "value": v} for k,v in data.items()]
            return [entries]
        else:
            return [None]
    if expr == 'from_entries':
        if isinstance(data, list):
            d = {}
            for item in data:
                if isinstance(item, dict) and 'key' in item and 'value' in item:
                    d[item['key']] = item['value']
            return [d]
        else:
            return [None]
    if expr.startswith('sort_by(') and expr.endswith(')'):
        inner = expr[8:-1].strip()
        if isinstance(data, list):
            def sort_key(item):
                res = eval_expr(item, inner, context)
                if res:
                    return res[0]
                return 0
            try:
                sorted_data = sorted(data, key=sort_key)
                return [sorted_data]
            except:
                return [data]
        else:
            return [data]
    m = re.match(r'^(.*)\s+as\s+\$([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*$', expr)
    if m:
        lhs = m.group(1).strip()
        var_name = m.group(2).strip()
        lhs_res = eval_expr(data, lhs, context)
        if lhs_res:
            context[var_name] = lhs_res[0]
        else:
            context[var_name] = None
        return lhs_res
    if 'ireduce' in expr:
        m = re.match(r'^(.*)\s+ireduce\s*\(\s*(.*)\s*;\s*(.*)\s*\)\s*$', expr)
        if m:
            left_part = m.group(1).strip()
            init_part = m.group(2).strip()
            reduce_part = m.group(3).strip()
            var_name = None
            m2 = re.match(r'^(.*)\s+as\s+\$([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*$', left_part)
            if m2:
                var_name = m2.group(2)
                all_docs = context.get('all_docs', [])
                init_val = eval_literal(init_part)
                if init_val is None:
                    if init_part == '{}':
                        init_val = {}
                    elif init_part == '[]':
                        init_val = []
                    elif init_part == '0':
                        init_val = 0
                    else:
                        try:
                            init_res = eval_expr({}, init_part, context)
                            init_val = init_res[0] if init_res else None
                        except:
                            init_val = eval_literal(init_part)
                acc = init_val
                for doc_item in all_docs:
                    new_ctx = dict(context)
                    if var_name:
                        new_ctx[var_name] = doc_item
                    res_list = eval_expr(acc, reduce_part, new_ctx)
                    if res_list:
                        acc = res_list[0]
                return [acc]
    for op in ('|=', '+=', '-=', '*=', '/=', '%=', '='):
        spaced_op = f' {op} '
        idx_spaced = find_top_level_op(expr, spaced_op)
        idx = idx_spaced
        found_op_len = len(spaced_op)
        if idx == -1:
            idx = find_top_level_op(expr, op)
            found_op_len = len(op)
        if idx != -1:
            if op == '=':
                if expr[idx:idx+2] == '==' or (idx>0 and expr[idx-1] in ('=', '!', '<', '>')):
                    continue
                if idx>0 and expr[idx-1] in ('|', '+', '-', '*', '/', '%'):
                    continue
            lhs = expr[:idx].strip()
            rhs = expr[idx+found_op_len:].strip()
            lhs_tokens = parse_path(lhs)
            rhs_res = eval_expr(data, rhs, context)
            rhs_val = rhs_res[0] if rhs_res else None
            if op == '|=':
                cur_vals = eval_path(data, lhs_tokens)
                cur_val = cur_vals[0] if cur_vals else None
                updated_list = eval_expr(cur_val, rhs, context)
                updated_val = updated_list[0] if updated_list else None
                set_path(data, lhs_tokens, updated_val)
                return [data]
            elif op == '=':
                set_path(data, lhs_tokens, rhs_val)
                return [data]
    for op in ('==', '!=', '<=', '>=', '<', '>', ' and ', ' or ', ' + ', ' - ', ' * ', ' / ', ' % '):
        idx = find_top_level_op(expr, op)
        if idx != -1:
            op_stripped = op.strip()
            lhs = expr[:idx].strip()
            rhs = expr[idx+len(op):].strip()
            lhs_res = eval_expr(data, lhs, context)
            rhs_res = eval_expr(data, rhs, context)
            lhs_val = lhs_res[0] if lhs_res else None
            rhs_val = rhs_res[0] if rhs_res else None
            if op_stripped == '*':
                if isinstance(lhs_val, dict) and isinstance(rhs_val, dict):
                    return [deep_merge(lhs_val, rhs_val)]
                elif isinstance(lhs_val, (int,float)) and isinstance(rhs_val, (int,float)):
                    return [lhs_val * rhs_val]
                else:
                    sys.stderr.write(f"Error: cannot multiply {type(lhs_val)} with {type(rhs_val)}\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
            elif op_stripped == '+':
                if isinstance(lhs_val, (int,float)) and isinstance(rhs_val, (int,float)):
                    return [lhs_val + rhs_val]
                elif isinstance(lhs_val, str) and isinstance(rhs_val, str):
                    return [lhs_val + rhs_val]
                elif isinstance(lhs_val, dict) and isinstance(rhs_val, dict):
                    return [deep_merge(lhs_val, rhs_val)]
                elif isinstance(lhs_val, str) or isinstance(rhs_val, str):
                    return [str(lhs_val if lhs_val is not None else "") + str(rhs_val if rhs_val is not None else "")]
                elif lhs_val is None:
                    return [rhs_val]
                elif rhs_val is None:
                    return [lhs_val]
                else:
                    try:
                        return [lhs_val + rhs_val]
                    except:
                        return [str(lhs_val) + str(rhs_val)]
            elif op_stripped == '-':
                if isinstance(lhs_val, (int,float)) and isinstance(rhs_val, (int,float)):
                    return [lhs_val - rhs_val]
                else:
                    return [None]
            elif op_stripped == '/':
                if isinstance(lhs_val, (int,float)) and isinstance(rhs_val, (int,float)):
                    return [lhs_val / rhs_val if rhs_val != 0 else None]
                else:
                    return [None]
            elif op_stripped == '%':
                if isinstance(lhs_val, (int,float)) and isinstance(rhs_val, (int,float)):
                    return [lhs_val % rhs_val]
                else:
                    return [None]
            elif op_stripped == '==':
                return [lhs_val == rhs_val]
            elif op_stripped == '!=':
                return [lhs_val != rhs_val]
            elif op_stripped == '<':
                try:
                    return [lhs_val < rhs_val]
                except:
                    return [False]
            elif op_stripped == '>':
                try:
                    return [lhs_val > rhs_val]
                except:
                    return [False]
            elif op_stripped == '<=':
                try:
                    return [lhs_val <= rhs_val]
                except:
                    return [False]
            elif op_stripped == '>=':
                try:
                    return [lhs_val >= rhs_val]
                except:
                    return [False]
            elif op_stripped == 'and':
                return [bool(lhs_val) and bool(rhs_val)]
            elif op_stripped == 'or':
                return [bool(lhs_val) or bool(rhs_val)]
    lit = eval_literal(expr)
    if lit is not None or expr in ('null', 'true', 'false', '0', '[]', '{}') or expr.startswith('"') or expr.startswith("'") or expr.startswith('{') or expr.startswith('['):
        return [lit]
    tokens = parse_path(expr)
    if tokens is not None:
        return eval_path(data, tokens)
    sys.stderr.write(f"Error: bad expression: {expr}\n")
    sys.exit(1)

def eval_condition(data, cond_expr, context):
    ops = ['==', '!=', '<=', '>=', '<', '>']
    for op in ops:
        if op in cond_expr:
            parts = cond_expr.split(op, 1)
            if len(parts) == 2:
                lhs = parts[0].strip()
                rhs = parts[1].strip()
                lhs_res = eval_expr(data, lhs, context)
                rhs_res = eval_expr(data, rhs, context)
                lhs_val = lhs_res[0] if lhs_res else None
                rhs_val = rhs_res[0] if rhs_res else None
                if rhs_res == [None] or not rhs_res:
                    lit = eval_literal(rhs)
                    rhs_val = lit if lit is not None else rhs
                if op == '==':
                    return lhs_val == rhs_val
                elif op == '!=':
                    return lhs_val != rhs_val
                elif op == '<':
                    try:
                        return lhs_val < rhs_val
                    except:
                        return False
                elif op == '>':
                    try:
                        return lhs_val > rhs_val
                    except:
                        return False
                elif op == '<=':
                    try:
                        return lhs_val <= rhs_val
                    except:
                        return False
                elif op == '>=':
                    try:
                        return lhs_val >= rhs_val
                    except:
                        return False
    res = eval_expr(data, cond_expr, context)
    if not res:
        return False
    val = res[0]
    if val is None or val is False:
        return False
    if val == [] or val == {}:
        return False
    return True

def eval_expr(data, expr, context):
    parts = split_expression(expr)
    if len(parts) > 1:
        current = [data]
        for part in parts:
            next_current = []
            for ctx_data in current:
                res = eval_expr_single(ctx_data, part, context)
                next_current.extend(res)
            current = next_current
        return current
    else:
        return eval_expr_single(data, expr, context)

This command loads _all_ yaml documents of _all_ yaml files and runs expression once
Useful when you need to run an expression across several yaml documents or files (like merge).
Note that it consumes more memory than eval.

Usage:
  yq eval-all [expression] [yaml_file1]... [flags]

Aliases:
  eval-all, ea

Examples:

# Merge f2.yml into f1.yml (in place)
yq eval-all --inplace 'select(fileIndex == 0) * select(fileIndex == 1)' f1.yml f2.yml
## the same command and expression using shortened names:
yq ea -i 'select(fi == 0) * select(fi == 1)' f1.yml f2.yml


# Merge all given files
yq ea '. as $item ireduce ({}; . * $item )' file1.yml file2.yml ...

# Pipe from STDIN
## use '-' as a filename to pipe from STDIN
cat file2.yml | yq ea '.a.b' file1.yml - file3.yml


Flags:
  -h, --help   help for eval-all

Global Flags:
  -C, --colors                            force print with colors
      --csv-auto-parse                    parse CSV YAML/JSON values (default true)
      --csv-separator char                CSV Separator character (default ,)
      --debug-node-info                   debug node info
  -e, --exit-status                       set exit status if there are no matches or null or false is returned
      --expression string                 forcibly set the expression argument. Useful when yq argument detection thinks your expression is a file.
      --from-file string                  Load expression from specified file.
  -f, --front-matter string               (extract|process) first input as yaml front-matter. Extract will pull out the yaml content, process will run the expression against the yaml content, leaving the remaining data intact
      --header-preprocess                 Slurp any header comments and separators before processing expression. (default true)
  -I, --indent int                        sets indent level for output (default 2)
  -i, --inplace                           update the file in place of first file given.
  -p, --input-format string               [auto|a|yaml|y|kyaml|ky|json|j|props|p|csv|c|tsv|t|xml|x|base64|uri|toml|hcl|h|lua|l|ini|i] parse format for input. (default "auto")
      --lua-globals                       output keys as top-level global variables
      --lua-prefix string                 prefix (default "return ")
      --lua-suffix string                 suffix (default ";\\n")
      --lua-unquoted                      output unquoted string keys (e.g. {foo="bar"})
  -M, --no-colors                         force print with no colors
  -N, --no-doc                            Don't print document separators (---)
  -0, --nul-output                        Use NUL char to separate values. If unwrap scalar is also set, fail if unwrapped scalar contains NUL char.
  -n, --null-input                        Don't read input, simply evaluate the expression given. Useful for creating docs from scratch.
  -o, --output-format string              [auto|a|yaml|y|kyaml|ky|json|j|props|p|csv|c|tsv|t|xml|x|base64|uri|toml|hcl|h|lua|l|ini|i] output format type. (default "auto")
  -P, --prettyPrint                       pretty print, shorthand for '... style = ""'

      --security-enable-system-operator   Enable system operator to allow execution of external commands.

      --split-exp-file string             Use a file to specify the split-exp expression.

BASH_COMPLETION = """# bash completion V2 for yq                                   -*- shell-script -*-

__yq_debug()
{
    if [[ -n ${BASH_COMP_DEBUG_FILE-} ]]; then
        echo "$*" >> "${BASH_COMP_DEBUG_FILE}"
    fi
}

# Macs have bash3 for which the bash-completion package doesn't include
# _init_completion. This is a minimal version of that function.
__yq_init_completion()
{
    COMPREPLY=()
    _get_comp_words_by_ref "$@" cur prev words cword
}

# This function calls the yq program to obtain the completion
# results and the directive.  It fills the 'out' and 'directive' vars.
__yq_get_completion_results() {
    local requestComp lastParam lastChar args

    # Prepare the command to request completions for the program.
    # Calling ${words[0]} instead of directly yq allows handling aliases
    args=("${words[@]:1}")
    requestComp="${words[0]} __complete ${args[*]}"

    lastParam=${words[$((${#words[@]}-1))]}
    lastChar=${lastParam:$((${#lastParam}-1)):1}
    __yq_debug "lastParam ${lastParam}, lastChar ${lastChar}"

    if [[ -z ${cur} && ${lastChar} != = ]]; then
        # If the last parameter is complete (there is a space following it)
        # We add an extra empty parameter so we can indicate this to the go method.
        __yq_debug "Adding extra empty parameter"
        requestComp="${requestComp} ''"
    fi

    # When completing a flag with an = (e.g., yq -n=<TAB>)
    # bash focuses on the part after the =, so we need to remove
    # the flag part from $cur
    if [[ ${cur} == -*=* ]]; then
        cur="${cur#*=}"
    fi

    __yq_debug "Calling ${requestComp}"
    # Use eval to handle any environment variables and such
    out=$(eval "${requestComp}" 2>/dev/null)

    # Extract the directive integer at the very end of the output following a colon (:)
    directive=${out##*:}

    # The rest is the completions so we strip the last line
    out=${out%:*}
    if [[ ${directive} == "${out}" ]]; then
        # There is only the directive - it was given as the only completion
        directive=${out}
        out=
    fi
}

__yq_process_completion_results() {
    local cur cword words
    __yq_debug "Processing completion results: ${out[*]}, directive: ${directive}"

    local noSpace=false
    local keepOrder=false
    if [[ ${directive} == *2* ]]; then
        noSpace=true
    fi
    if [[ ${directive} == *32* ]]; then
        keepOrder=true
    fi

    if [[ ${directive} == *4* ]]; then
        # File completion disabled
        return
    fi

    if $keepOrder; then
        # We need to sort completions in the same order as they are returned
        # and discard those that no longer match the completion word.
        # For this we need to parse the completions.
        # This is the simplest version that works: we just check prefix
        local -a sorted=()
        while IFS= read -r comp; do
            if [[ ${comp} == "${cur}"* ]]; then
                sorted+=("${comp}")
            fi
        done <<< "${out}"
        out="${sorted[*]}"
    fi

    if [[ ${cur} == -* ]]; then
        # We are completing a flag, we don't want file names
        return
    fi

    # If no completions found, we want to trigger file completion
    if [[ -z ${out} ]]; then
        if [[ ${directive} != *8* ]]; then
            # Not filtered by file extension
            COMPREPLY=()
            _filedir
            return
        fi
    fi

    # Check if we need to filter file extension
    if [[ ${directive} == *8* ]]; then
        # Filter file extension
        local filter
        filter=$(echo "${out}" | tr " " "\\n" | tr -d "\\r" | head -n1)
        COMPREPLY=()
        _filedir "@(${filter})"
        return
    fi

    # Finally, we got our completions
    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "${out}" -- "${cur}") )

    # Check if we need to add a space after completion
    if $noSpace; then
        if [[ $(type -t compopt) = "builtin" ]]; then
            compopt -o nospace
        fi
    fi
}

# This is the main function that is called when completion is triggered.
__start_yq()
{
    local cur prev cword words
    __yq_debug "Starting completion"

    # Call the bash completion initialization function
    __yq_init_completion

    # Prepare the command to request completions for the program.
    __yq_debug "cur is ${cur}, words[*] is ${words[*]}, #words[@] is ${#words[@]}, cword is $cword"

    # The user could have moved the cursor backwards on the command-line.
    # We need to trigger completion from the $cword location, so we need
    # to truncate the command-line ($words) up to the $cword location.
    words=("${words[@]:0:$cword+1}")
    __yq_debug "Truncated words[*]: ${words[*]},"

    local out directive
    __yq_get_completion_results
    __yq_process_completion_results
}

if [[ $(type -t compopt) = "builtin" ]]; then
    complete -o default -F __start_yq yq
else
    complete -o default -o nospace -F __start_yq yq
fi

# ex: ts=4 sw=4 et filetype=sh
"""

ZSH_COMPLETION = """#compdef yq
compdef _yq yq

# zsh completion for yq                                   -*- shell-script -*-

__yq_debug()
{
    local file="$BASH_COMP_DEBUG_FILE"
    if [[ -n ${file} ]]; then
        echo "$*" >> "${file}"
    fi
}

_yq()
{
    local shellCompDirectiveError=1
    local shellCompDirectiveNoSpace=2
    local shellCompDirectiveNoFileComp=4
    local shellCompDirectiveFilterFileExt=8
    local shellCompDirectiveFilterDirs=16
    local shellCompDirectiveKeepOrder=32

    local lastParam lastChar flagPrefix requestComp out directive comp lastComp noSpace keepOrder
    local -a completions

    __yq_debug "\n========= starting completion logic =========="
    __yq_debug "CURRENT: ${CURRENT}, words[*]: ${words[*]}"

    # The user could have moved the cursor backwards on the command-line.
    # We need to trigger completion from the $CURRENT location, so we need
    # to truncate the command-line ($words) up to the $CURRENT location.
    # (We cannot use $CURSOR as its value does not work when a command is an alias.)
    words=("${=words[1,CURRENT]}")
    __yq_debug "Truncated words[*]: ${words[*]},"

    lastParam=${words[-1]}
    lastChar=${lastParam[-1]}
    __yq_debug "lastParam: ${lastParam}, lastChar: ${lastChar}"

    # For zsh, when completing a flag with an = (e.g., yq -n=<TAB>)
    # completions must be prefixed with the flag
    setopt local_options BASH_REMATCH
    if [[ "${lastParam}" =~ '-.*=' ]]; then
        # We are dealing with a flag with an =
        flagPrefix="-P ${BASH_REMATCH}"
    fi

    # Prepare the command to obtain completions
    requestComp="${words[1]} __complete ${words[2,-1]}"
    if [ "${lastChar}" = "" ]; then
        # If the last parameter is complete (there is a space following it)
        # We add an extra empty parameter so we can indicate this to the go method.
        __yq_debug "Adding extra empty parameter"
        requestComp="${requestComp} \\"\\""
    fi

    __yq_debug "Calling ${requestComp}"
    # Use eval to handle any environment variables and such
    out=$(eval ${requestComp} 2>/dev/null)
    directive=${out##*:}

    # The rest is the completions so we remove the last line
    local -a comps
    out=${out%:*}
    comps=(${(s: :)out})

    # The directive is a bit map, we need to check its values
    lastComp=${words[-1]}

    if [ $directive -eq 1 ]; then
        # shellCompDirectiveError
        return
    fi
    noSpace=false
    if [ $((directive & $shellCompDirectiveNoSpace)) -ne 0 ]; then
        noSpace=true
    fi
    keepOrder=false
    if [ $((directive & $shellCompDirectiveKeepOrder)) -ne 0 ]; then
        keepOrder=true
    fi

    if [ $((directive & $shellCompDirectiveNoFileComp)) -ne 0 ]; then
        # No file completion
        if $noSpace; then
            # No space, but still need to complete flags?
            _describe 'values' completions -Q -S ''
        else
            _describe 'values' completions
        fi
        return
    fi

    # Check if we need to filter file extension
    if [ $((directive & $shellCompDirectiveFilterFileExt)) -ne 0 ]; then
        # File extension filtering
        local filter
        filter=$(echo ${comps[1]} | tr -d '\\r')
        _files -g "*.$filter"
        return
    fi

    # If completions contain an empty string (e.g., when there is a flag with value and no completion)
    # we want to complete file names?
    if [ ${#comps} -eq 0 ]; then
        if [ $((directive & $shellCompDirectiveFilterDirs)) -ne 0 ]; then
            _files -/
            return
        else
            _files
            return
        fi
    fi

    if $noSpace; then
        # We have an extra flag that prevents adding a space after completion
        if [[ "${lastComp}" == -* ]]; then
            # Completing flag name, keep description
            _describe -Q -S '' 'values' completions
        else
            # Completing flag value or arg, no description?
            eval "completions=(${completions})"
            _describe -Q -S '' 'values' completions
        fi
    else
        _describe 'values' completions
    fi
}

# don't run the completion function when being source-ed or eval-ed
if [ "$funcstack[1]" = "_yq" ]; then
    _yq
fi
"""

FISH_COMPLETION = """# fish completion for yq                                   -*- shell-script -*-

function __yq_debug
    set -l file "$BASH_COMP_DEBUG_FILE"
    if test -n "$file"
        echo "$argv" >> $file
    end
end

function __yq_perform_completion
    __yq_debug "Starting __yq_perform_completion"

    # Extract all args except the last one
    set -l args (commandline -opc)
    # Extract the last arg and escape it in case it is a space
    set -l lastArg (string escape -- (commandline -ct))

    __yq_debug "args: $args"
    __yq_debug "last arg: $lastArg"

    # Disable ActiveHelp which is not supported for fish shell
    set -l requestComp "YQ_ACTIVE_HELP=0 $args[1] __complete $args[2..-1] $lastArg"

    __yq_debug "Calling $requestComp"
    set -l results (eval $requestComp 2> /dev/null)

    # Some programs may output extra empty lines after the directive.
    # Let's ignore them or else it will break completion.
    # Ref: https://github.com/spf13/cobra/issues/1279
    for line in $results[-1..1]
        if test (string trim -- $line) = ""
            # Found an empty line, remove it
            set results $results[1..-2]
        else
            # Found non-empty line, we have our proper output
            break
        end
    end

    set -l comps $results[1..-2]
    set -l directiveLine $results[-1]

    # For Fish, when completing a flag with an = (e.g., <program> -n=<TAB>)
    # completions must be prefixed with the flag
    set -l flagPrefix (string split --max 1 "=" -- $lastArg)
    set -l complist
    for comp in $comps
        set -l comp_split (string split --max 1 "\\t" -- $comp)
        if test (count $comp_split) -eq 2
            set -l comp_name $comp_split[1]
            set -l comp_desc $comp_split[2]
            if test -n "$flagPrefix" -a "$flagPrefix" != "$lastArg"
                # Completing a flag with an =
                set complist $complist "$flagPrefix=$comp_name"
            else
                set complist $complist "$comp_name\\t$comp_desc"
            end
        else
            if test -n "$flagPrefix" -a "$flagPrefix" != "$lastArg"
                set complist $complist "$flagPrefix=$comp"
            else
                set complist $complist "$comp"
            end
        end
    end

    # For Fish, the directive is a number, we need to check its bits
    set -l directive (string trim -- $directiveLine | string split : --)[-1]
    set -l directive (string trim -- $directive)

    # Check if we need to handle file extension filtering
    if test (math "$directive & 8") -ne 0
        # File extension filtering
        set -l filter (string trim -- $comps[1] | string split "\\t" --)[1]
        __fish_complete_path "*."$filter
        return
    end

    # If no completions, complete file names
    if test (count $comps) -eq 0
        if test (math "$directive & 16") -ne 0
            __fish_complete_directories
        else
            __fish_complete_path
        end
        return
    end

    # Finally, complete
    for comp in $complist
        echo -e "$comp"
    end
end

function __yq_prepare_completions
    # Start with an empty list of completions
    set -l args (commandline -opc)
    set -l lastArg (commandline -ct)

    # Check if the last arg is empty (e.g., when there is a space after last word)
    if test -z "$lastArg"
        # Add an empty arg to indicate that we need to complete after last word
        set -l requestComp "YQ_ACTIVE_HELP=0 $args[1] __complete $args[2..-1] \\"\\""
    else
        set -l requestComp "YQ_ACTIVE_HELP=0 $args[1] __complete $args[2..-1] $lastArg"
    end

    # For fish, we need to handle active help
    set -l results (eval $requestComp 2> /dev/null)

    # Check for directive
    set -l directiveLine $results[-1]

    # The rest are completions
    set -l comps $results[1..-2]

    # Check directive
    set -l directive (string trim -- $directiveLine | string split : --)[-1]
    set -l directive (string trim -- $directive)

    # For order preservation
    set -l keepOrder false
    if test (math "$directive & 32") -ne 0
        set keepOrder true
    end

    # Set global var
    set -g __yq_comp_results $comps
    set -g __yq_directive $directive
    set -g __yq_keep_order $keepOrder
end

function __yq_clear_perform_completion_once_result
    set -e __yq_perform_completion_once_result
end

function __yq_requires_order_preservation
    test "$__yq_keep_order" = "true"
    return $status
end

# Only do this if the program can be found, or else fish may print some errors; besides,
# the existing completions will only be loaded if the program can be found.
if type -q "yq"
    # The space after the program name is essential to trigger completion for the program
    # and not completion of the program name itself.
    # Also, we use '> /dev/null 2>&1' since '&>' is not supported in older versions of fish.
    complete --do-complete "yq " > /dev/null 2>&1
end

# Remove any pre-existing completions for the program since we will be handling all of them.
complete -c yq -e

# this will get called after the two calls below and clear the $__yq_perform_completion_once_result global
complete -c yq -n '__yq_clear_perform_completion_once_result'
# The call to __yq_prepare_completions will setup __yq_comp_results
# which provides the program's completion choices.
# If this doesn't require order preservation, we don't use the -k flag
complete -c yq -n 'not __yq_requires_order_preservation && __yq_prepare_completions' -f -a '$__yq_comp_results'
# otherwise we use the -k flag
complete -k -c yq -n '__yq_requires_order_preservation && __yq_prepare_completions' -f -a '$__yq_comp_results'
"""
